Task_Name: Task B: Contemporaneous Surrounding Non-Enhancing Dynamics
Target_Endpoint: Predefined Volumetric Change Endpoint: delta_ET >= 0.5 mL and rel_ET >= 25% (strictly expert-derived)
Permitted_Information: Baseline compartment volumes at t1 + nominal inter-scan interval gap + follow-up deltas in surrounding edema (SNFH), cavity (RC), and necrosis (NETC). Total tumor delta and follow-up ET are strictly excluded to prevent algebraic leakage.
Clinical_Semantics: Task B measures contemporaneous imaging-change association between non-enhancing tissue shifts and enhancing tumor reactivation; it is NOT a future clinical prognostic forecasting model.
